disagreements.natureOfConflict: source-consumer-drive-index measures realized owner-reported problems across all vehicle systems and rates the candidate above average. source-autotrust-reliability-survey predicts reliability primarily from powertrain technical service bulletin history and rates the same candidate's powertrain component category below average because of continuously variable transmission service bulletins. Both figures are current and traceable; they disagree because they measure different things (realized owner complaints vs. predicted powertrain risk), not because either source is stale or wrong.
